product_overview: Waqt is a frictionless e-commerce web application for watches, wallets, and accessories, designed for fast guest checkout with no customer registration or login. It uses phone number as the unique customer identifier and supports product browsing, cart management, and multiple payment methods.
core_goals: Provide a high-conversion shopping experience without customer accounts or passwords
Display active products with clear pricing, images, stock, and details
Support guest checkout using name, phone number, and address
Track anonymous browsing sessions and link them to customers after purchase
Allow checkout with COD, Vodafone Cash, and InstaPay payment methods

features.name: Home Page
features.description: Landing page that showcases featured watches and enables direct shopping entry points.
user_flows: GET /api/products?featured=true to load featured products -> Receive 200 with featured product list -> User selects a product -> GET /api/products/{id} to load product details -> Receive 200 with product information

GET /api/products?featured=true to load featured products -> Receive 200 with featured product list -> User selects a product -> GET /api/products/{id} with an invalid id -> Receive 404 product not found

features.name: Products List
features.description: Browse all active watches, wallets, and accessories available for purchase.
user_flows: GET /api/products to load all active products -> Receive 200 with product grid data -> User opens a product card -> GET /api/products/{id} to retrieve item details -> Receive 200 with full product data
GET /api/products to load all active products -> Receive 200 with product grid data -> GET /api/products/{id} with a deleted or inactive product id -> Receive 404 or 400 depending on validation

features.name: Product Details
features.description: View detailed product information, stock availability, and purchase actions like add to cart or buy now.
user_flows: GET /api/products/{id} to load detailed product info -> Receive 200 with description, images, stock, and reviews -> POST /api/cart/items with productId and quantity -> Receive 200 confirming item added to cart -> Proceed to checkout
GET /api/products/{id} with an invalid product id -> Receive 404 not found -> UI blocks add to cart / buy now actions -> User remains on product error state

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Review and manage selected items before checkout, including updating quantities and removing products.
user_flows: POST /api/cart/items with productId and quantity to add an item -> Receive 200 with updated cart -> PATCH /api/cart/items/{id} with a new quantity -> Receive 200 with recalculated totals -> DELETE /api/cart/items/{id} to remove an item -> Receive 200 with empty or updated cart state

POST /api/cart/items with productId missing or quantity invalid -> Receive 400 validation error -> UI shows message and cart remains unchanged -> GET /api/cart to confirm no update -> Receive 200 with previous cart state

features.name: Checkout
features.description: Complete a guest purchase using name, phone number, address, and a supported payment method without creating an account.
user_flows: POST /api/checkout with cart items, fullName, phoneNumber, address, and paymentMethod=CASH_ON_DELIVERY -> Receive 200 with created order -> Firestore creates or updates customer by phoneNumber -> Firestore links sessionId to phoneNumber -> Order is marked pending or confirmed based on payment rules
POST /api/checkout with empty cart or missing mandatory fields such as phoneNumber -> Receive 400 validation error -> Order is not created -> Customer record and session link are not updated

POST /api/checkout with paymentMethod=Vodafone Cash or InstaPay and valid customer details -> Receive 200 with payment-specific order response -> Create order document in Firestore -> Update customer totals and link anonymous session -> Receive confirmation for next payment step
